title: List deployment runs
summary: List every attempt to trigger a deployment, newest first, optionally narrowed to one deployment or to the runs that failed.

parameters.name: deployment_id
parameters.description: Only runs of this deployment. Omitted, every run is returned.

parameters.name: has_error
parameters.description: `true` returns only runs that recorded an error, `false` only runs that did not. Any other value is refused by name.

title: Get deployment run
summary: Retrieve one deployment run by the id a `deployment_run` event carries in `data.id`.

response.name: deployment_id
response.description: Deployment this run attempted to trigger.

response.name: session_id
response.description: Session the run created, or null when it failed before one existed.

response.name: error
response.description: `{type, message}` on a failed run and null on a successful one. `type` is currently the local `deployment_run_failed`; the published cause vocabulary is not implemented.

response.name: agent
response.description: `{type, id, version}`. Taken from the session the run created, so it is the agent that ran. On a failed run `version` is null and `id` is the deployment's current agent.

response.name: trigger_context
response.description: `{type}` is `schedule` for a timed run and `manual` for a hand-triggered one. `scheduled_at` is not recorded by this runtime and is omitted rather than filled with the start time.
